target_customer: Independent restaurants and food suppliers in the UAE and Saudi Arabia
problem: Independent restaurants buy food supplies alone and pay more than chains, and ordering from suppliers is manual.
business_model: B2B procurement marketplace with supplier fees, plus invoice financing and buy now pay later

founders.name: Manar Alkassar
founders.background_notes: From YC profile; Sirrix exited to Rohde & Schwarz per the same page.

competitors.name: FIFOplus
competitors.what: Saudi B2B marketplace for restaurant food supply

competitors.name: Vendease
competitors.what: Nigerian online food supply marketplace for restaurants

technical_complexity.rationale: Ordering, catalog and ERP sync are standard; the later AI negotiation claim is the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregated buying volume improves prices, but suppliers and restaurants can multi-home.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Foodics became a partner in January 2023 rather than a competitor.

market_need_then: Company cites independents paying about 12 percent more than chains; a Gulf food service market with manual ordering by phone and WhatsApp (company framing).

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, concise and benefit driven, e.g. 'Save more. Order faster. Pay later.'

brand_strength.rationale: Short rename and a clear tagline, but no brand press beyond funding news.

pivots.why: YC description now frames the company around AI agents aggregating demand; timing not stated

outcome_analysis: Kaso, renamed from Elkaso, raised a 2.1 million dollar pre-seed in 2021 and joined YC in Winter 2022. It added a 10.5 million dollar seed in July 2023 and now claims over 5,000 restaurants and 2,000 suppliers across MENA. Serial founder experience and regional investors helped; it remains active with no shutdown or acquisition found.
notes: Pre-seed 2.1M USD reported by Wamda, Zawya, MartechVibe; seed 10.5M USD by Wamda, The National, Entrepreneur ME. YC investment amount not reported. CB Insights lists 15M USD on 2023-10 and 28.1M USD total; unverified. Headquarters is reported as Dubai by some and Saudi by others. Founder education not found. CB Insights also lists Bonnie Susilo as a founder; not on YC page, not recorded. Competitor pages are undated CB Insights comparisons; no dated 2022 source found. The pivot entry reflects the current YC wording and is not a dated pivot. No shutdown or layoff news found.
